description: This file defines an interface (ITraceMedia) for trace media handling within the WPEFramework's Trace namespace. It declares a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method Output for outputting trace information, and includes external dependencies for trace control and module management.

classes.name: ITraceMedia
classes.description: An interface for trace media output, providing a virtual destructor and a pure virtual Output method to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs trace information given filename, line number, class name, and trace data.
